mapper.insert: INSERT INTO durable_task_runs ( id, task_type, queue_name, operation, status, step, payload_version, payload_json, checkpoint_json, result_json, resumable, attempt, max_attempts, idempotency_key, retry_of_run_id, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, heartbeat_at, available_at, progress_current, progress_total, current_item, error_code, error_message, queued_at, started_at, completed_at, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskType}, #{queueName}, #{operation}, #{status}, #{step}, #{payloadVersion}, #{payloadJson}, #{checkpointJson}, #{resultJson}, #{resumable}, #{attempt}, #{maxAttempts}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{retryOfRunId}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{heartbeatAt}, #{availableAt}, #{progressCurrent}, #{progressTotal}, #{currentItem}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{queuedAt}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM durable_task_runs WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'CANCELLING') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM durable_task_runs WHERE queue_name = #{queueName} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND available_at <= #{now} ORDER BY available_at ASC, queued_at ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE durable_task_runs SET status = 'RUNNING', step = CASE WHEN status = 'RETRY_WAIT' THEN 'RESUMING' ELSE operation END, attempt = attempt + 1, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, heartbeat_at = #{now}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), completed_at = NULL, duration_ms = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND queue_name = #{queueName} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND available_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM durable_task_runs active WHERE active.queue_name = #{queueName} AND active.status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') )

UPDATE durable_task_runs SET status = #{status}, step = 'COMPLETED', result_json = #{resultJson}, progress_current = #{progressCurrent}, progress_total = #{progressTotal}, current_item = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt}, duration_ms = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAX(0, #{completedAt} - started_at) END, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING')

UPDATE durable_task_runs SET status = 'FAILED', step = 'FAILED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, duration_ms = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAX(0, #{completedAt} - started_at) END, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING')

UPDATE durable_task_runs SET status = 'INTERRUPTED', step = 'INTERRUPTED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, duration_ms = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAX(0, #{completedAt} - started_at) END, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING')

UPDATE durable_task_runs SET status = 'CANCELLED', step = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, duration_ms = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE MAX(0, #{completedAt} - started_at) END, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, error_message = #{message}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT')
